confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of London price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct recall is weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given wide July peak-season variation by area and booking lead time. Local prices were translated at an assumed sterling-dollar level near 1.34, so currency drift could move USD values by several percent. The FX figure came from web-search snippets of rba.gov.au, not a direct page read; confirm the 2026-10-15 entry if it was not yet published at generation time.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors rest on the model's general knowledge of London itself, with cocktail and wine set relative to the beer anchor and accommodation raised for July peak demand.
